title: LEGENDARY WIPE RECAP
description: Failed extractions now end with a dramatic squad dossier showing last stands, heroic mistakes, suspicious bravery, and one shareable casualty stamp shaped like a tiny corporate medal.
consequence: The wipe gets a press kit and a eulogy.

title: CAMPFIRE OATH START
description: New worlds now begin with players carving a personal oath into the first camp marker, skipping referral banners, seasonal invite boosts, and the usual frontier welcome circus.
consequence: The campfire chooses a vow over a billboard.

title: CROSSOVER PROPHECY PARADE
description: The opening quest now rotates through guest mascots, sponsored destiny banners, limited kart robes, and a ceremonial starting horn that changes brands every weekend.
consequence: The call to adventure gets a brand calendar.

title: ORIGIN STORY WIZARD
description: Character creation now generates a personalized heroic backstory through twelve motivation sliders, three trauma presets, and a mandatory destiny questionnaire before spawning.
consequence: The backstory arrives with multiple choice fatigue.
